ITEM 1 | Small round green heads, mostly whole, some halved, with a few dark-brown charred or browned spots on outer leaves; dense, firm, slightly glossy surface; clustered in the upper-left of the plate covering roughly 20% of the plate, each head about 2-3 cm across; sits directly on the red plate | 110

ITEM 2 | Pale green cubes with a smooth, slightly translucent cut face and crisp-looking edges, roughly 2 x 2 x 2 cm pieces, arranged in a loose cluster in the lower-left-center; no visible cooking marks, appears raw or lightly cooked, matte to slightly moist; covers roughly 20% of the plate | 120

ITEM 3 | Bright green florets with tree-like branching stems, tightly budded tops, matte surface with fine texture, some stems pale green; several florets about 3-5 cm across clustered on the right side covering roughly 20% of the plate; no visible browning or sauce; sits directly on the red plate | 130

ITEM 4 | Small thin orange-red strip, about 2 cm long, matte and slightly dry, lying between the cubes and the Brussels-style heads on the left side of the plate | 2
